summary: Requires the Secretary of Energy to establish a program to strengthen the domestic science and engineering workforce through partnerships among institutions of higher education, National Laboratories, other Federal science agencies, and industry to support accelerated doctoral programs, and for other purposes.

title: NTIA Policy and Cybersecurity Coordination Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. (2025-06-12)
summary: Amends the National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act to establish the Office of Policy Development and Cybersecurity.

title: National Strategy for Combating Scams Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (2025-12-04)
summary: Directs an FBI-led federal working group to coordinate a national strategy against scams, including AI-enabled scams.

title: STOP Scams Against Seniors Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (2026-06-17)
summary: Authorizes Byrne-JAG grant funds for elder-justice task forces targeting scams against seniors

title: Export Control Enforcement and Enhancement Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs. (2026-06-18)
summary: Strengthens U.S. national security by expediting additions to the Commerce Department’s Entity List and restricting foreign access to sensitive American technologies.

title: Ratepayer Protection Act
cosponsors: Tuberville (R-AL); Moody (R-FL); Ricketts (R-NE); Marshall (R-KS); Kennedy (R-LA); Collins (R-ME); Graham (R-SC); Cotton (R-AR); Hoeven (R-ND); Britt (R-AL); Cornyn (R-TX); Ernst (R-IA); Armstrong (R-OK); Hagerty (R-TN); Young (R-IN); Fischer (R-NE)
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. (2026-07-16)
summary: Amends the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 to establish a Federal standard relating to the recovery of the full, incremental costs of upgrades that serve large-load customers, and for other purposes.

title: Advancing American Wi-Fi Against Foreign Adversaries Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. (2026-08-06)
summary: Requires the Secretary of Commerce, acting through the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Communications and Information, to develop a plan for how the United States will advance and advocate for Wi-Fi and other unlicensed technologies, and for other purposes.

title: STRIDE Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (2026-09-15)
summary: Aims to protect global semiconductor supply chains and prevent adversarial nations from acquiring critical technology.

title: Kids Online Safety Act
action: Forwarded by Subcommittee to Full Committee in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 13 - 10. (2025-12-11)
summary: Requires covered online platforms to provide safeguards and parental tools to protect minors, including privacy protections and ways to report harm. Establishes federal and state enforcement responsibilities.

title: Data Center Transparency Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works. (2026-09-30)
summary: Requires federal reports on data centers’ effects on air and water quality and their electricity consumption, including impacts on residential energy costs.
